source: 3HAC098387 RAPID Instructions, Functions and Data Types, RobotWare 8 (names, syntax and types; summaries in our own words)

entries.name: BytesReset
entries.summary: Sets every element of a byte array to 0.

entries.name: BytesToVal
entries.summary: Decodes a value of any data type from a byte array (optionally a slice of it); TRUE when it worked.

entries.name: CamStartSetParameter
entries.summary: Begins changing a named camera parameter without waiting for the camera; CamWaitSetParameter waits for it.

entries.name: CamWaitSetParameter
entries.summary: Waits until the camera has finished a parameter change started by CamStartSetParameter.

entries.name: CapInitSupervision
entries.summary: Clears and prepares CAP process supervision before new conditions are set up.

entries.name: CapRemoveSupervision
entries.summary: Takes I/O conditions out of CAP supervision again.

entries.name: CapSetDOAtStop
entries.summary: Names a digital output and the value CAP writes to it when the process stops.

entries.name: CapSetupSupervision
entries.summary: Adds an I/O signal condition that CAP watches during a process phase.

entries.name: Concat
entries.summary: Joins two strings into one (the \Remaining argument receives what did not fit).

entries.name: Continue
entries.summary: Skips the rest of the current loop pass and starts the next one (FOR / WHILE).

entries.name: DebugBreak
entries.summary: Halts execution at this line while debugging; ignored in normal runs.

entries.name: FitLine
entries.summary: Least-squares fit of a straight line through a set of points, with optional fit-error results.

entries.name: FitPlane
entries.summary: Least-squares fit of a plane through a set of points, with optional fit-error results.

entries.name: FitSphere
entries.summary: Least-squares fit of a sphere (centre and radius) through a set of points.

entries.name: GetNextOption
entries.summary: Steps through the RobotWare options installed on the controller, one name per call.

entries.name: GetNextProduct
entries.summary: Steps through the products installed on the controller, one name (and version) per call.

entries.name: GetTorqueMargin
entries.summary: The smallest motor torque margin seen since ResetTorqueMargin, for a robot or external axis.

entries.name: ICapPathPos
entries.summary: Orders an interrupt that reports the weld centre-line position while CAP weaves.

entries.name: IOActivate
entries.summary: Enables an I/O device from the program and waits up to MaxTime for it.

entries.name: IODeactivate
entries.summary: Disables an I/O device from the program and waits up to MaxTime for it.

entries.name: iodevice_state
entries.summary: The state of an I/O device, as IODeviceState returns it.

entries.name: IODeviceMute
entries.summary: Turns the event-log messages of an I/O device off (\On) or back on (\Off).

entries.name: IODeviceState
entries.summary: Reads the physical or logical state of an I/O device.

entries.name: ionetwork_state
entries.summary: The state of an I/O network, as IONetworkState returns it.

entries.name: IONetworkState
entries.summary: Reads the physical or logical state of an I/O network.

entries.name: JSONFromVal
entries.summary: Turns a RAPID data object into JSON text (a translationdata table can rename components).

entries.name: JSONToVal
entries.summary: Fills a RAPID data object from JSON text (a translationdata table can rename keys).

entries.name: MatrixAdd
entries.summary: Adds two matrices element by element into a result matrix.

entries.name: MatrixInverse
entries.summary: Inverts a square matrix into a result matrix.

entries.name: MatrixMult
entries.summary: Multiplies a matrix by a scalar, a vector or another matrix.
entries.syntax: MatrixMult A [\A_m] [\A_n] Scalar | Vector | B [\B_m] [\B_n] ResultVector | Result [\Result_m] [\Result_n]

entries.name: MatrixReset
entries.summary: Sets every element of a matrix to 0.

entries.name: MatrixSub
entries.summary: Subtracts one matrix from another element by element.

entries.name: MatrixTranspose
entries.summary: Writes the transpose of a matrix into a result matrix.

entries.name: MoveAbsL
entries.summary: Linear TCP move whose destination is given as axis angles (a jointtarget).

entries.name: Rand
entries.summary: A random whole number from 0 to RAND_MAX, optionally from a given seed.

entries.name: ReadDnum
entries.summary: Reads one number as dnum from a text file or serial device.

entries.name: ResetData
entries.summary: Puts a data object back to its declared initial value.

entries.name: SafetyControllerGetGroupChecksum
entries.summary: The checksum of a named protected group in the safety controller's configuration.

entries.name: SafetyControllerGetNextGroupName
entries.summary: Steps through the names of the safety configuration's protected groups.

entries.name: StrFormat
entries.summary: Builds a string from a text with numbered placeholders filled by the \Arg values.

entries.name: StrSize
entries.summary: The size of a string in bytes (a UTF-8 character can take more than one).

entries.name: translationdata
entries.summary: Pairs a RAPID component name with a JSON key name for JSONFromVal / JSONToVal.

entries.name: TriggAbsJ
entries.summary: Move to an absolute axis position (jointtarget) that fires trigger events on the way.
entries.syntax: TriggAbsJ [\Conc] ToJointPos [\ID] [\NoEoffs] Speed [\T] Trigg_1 | TriggArray [\T2] [\T3] [\T4] [\T5] [\T6] [\T7] [\T8] [\KeepStartPath] [\KeepEndPath] Zone [\Inpos] Tool [\WObj] [\TLoad]

entries.name: UIDisplay
entries.summary: Shows a predefined screen on the FlexPendant for the operator, with optional arguments.

entries.name: uidisplaynum
entries.summary: Identifies the screen UIDisplay shows.

entries.name: ValToBytes
entries.summary: Encodes a value of any data type into a byte array; returns how many bytes it used.

entries.name: WristOpt
entries.summary: Measures four wrist positions to tune TCP reorientation of the robot's wrist.
entries.syntax: WristOpt Pos1 Pos2 Pos3 Pos4 CalPosAx4 CalPosAx5
